posts.title: Five Years with Hugo
posts.description: During a break over Christmas 2020, I rebuilt this site, moving from WordPress to Hugo . After more than 5 years of publishing with Hugo, I’d like to share what I’ve learned, what’s worked, what hasn’t, and why for once, I’m happy with the platform I’m using. This review builds on two recent articles, Five Hundred , a retrospective of 500 posts to this site, and Lessons Learned from 20 Years & Why

posts.description: Amongst the steady stream of marketing emails for gift cards and other last minute gifts in the days before Christmas, buried in the noise sent when people are least likely to see it, was a notice.
